parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: B1: separate correctly, ∫1/[x(300 − x)]dx = ∫(1/1495)dt. B1: correct integration of the t term, e.g. t or t/1495. B1: state or imply partial fractions A/x + B/(300 − x). M1: correct method for A or B, giving A = B = 1/300; the scaled values 1495A = 1495B = 299/60 may be seen. A1: obtain (1495/300)ln x − (1495/300)ln(300 − x), or equivalent. M1: use t = 0, x = 1 to evaluate a constant, or use these as limits, in a solution containing ln x, ln(300 − x) and t. A1: obtain a correct form, e.g. (1495/300)ln x − (1495/300)ln(300 − x) − t = −(1495/300)ln 299. M1: use logarithm laws twice to obtain an expression for t. A1: t = (299/60)ln[299x/(300 − x)], or an equivalent single logarithm. [Total: 9]
